title: Compliance lab: spot the violation
objectives: Apply the rules to realistic scenarios.
Choose the compliant action under time pressure.
body_md:
Use the rules you have learnt on short cases. For each, ask: **is it a recommendation, is there a conflict, is information public, and is the claim fair?**

## Case 1: the friendly forward

An analyst forwards a client the draft report one day early. *Problem:* selective disclosure and a possible front-running risk. **Fix:** release to all at the same time.

## Case 2: the sponsored note

A company pays the firm and asks for a 'Buy'. *Problem:* compensation influences the rating. **Fix:** decline or disclose and keep independence; no pre-agreed rating.

## Case 3: the personal trade

An analyst buys the stock three days before publishing a Buy. *Problem:* trading in the restriction window and front running. **Fix:** pre-clear, wait out the window.

## Case 4: the WhatsApp tip

A staff member posts 'Buy XYZ, target 500' in a public group. *Problem:* unregistered, unrecorded recommendation. **Fix:** use approved channels only.

## Case 5: the old target

A report from six months ago is still circulating with the old target after a profit warning. *Problem:* stale, misleading. **Fix:** update or withdraw.

> **Exam tip:** Most scenario questions test one clear principle; find it first.
example: A firm sells a 'preview' of next week's report to premium clients. That is selective disclosure; every client should get the report at the same time.
say: All clients receive reports at the same time.
Our research is independent of any fees from the companies we cover.
never: Send the draft to our best clients first.
The company paid us, so the rating is Buy.

check.q: Giving a preview of a report only to some clients is:
check.why: All clients should receive research at the same time.

check.q: A sponsored 'Buy' agreed before analysis is:
check.why: Ratings must follow analysis, not payments.

check.q: A stale report with an outdated target should be:
check.why: Misleading, outdated research should be corrected.
